description:
Sample Posterior

Samples parameter values from the trained posterior distribution, conditioned on a selected observed feature vector.

arguments.posterior: A trained SBI posterior object returned by the training step. It must support sampling (e.g., provide a sample() method).
arguments.X_scaled: Observed data point of shape (1, n_features) or (n_features,). This is the target observation for which we want to infer parameters.
arguments.num_samples: Number of posterior samples to draw.
arguments.obs_idx: Row index used to select the observation from the standardized feature matrix. Default is 0.
arguments.output_dir: Output folder path where resulted samples are saved (used by viewers/plots).
